description: the Lady of the Stars, a celestial goddess made of the night sky, her long cloak and the hem of her gown dissolving into a swirling violet and magenta galaxy full of bright stars, ornate armour of radiant pearl white and gold, a diadem of seven floating golden stars above her head, a huge glowing golden crescent moon behind her as a halo, two wings made of glowing constellation lines and stars, eyes glowing white, holding a tall bow of pure white light with an arrow like a falling star with a fiery tail, the whole bow inside the image, a palette of deep violet, magenta, gold and white starlight; young woman, light tan skin, long straight black hair in a high ponytail, a slim oval face; standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet, with everything around it, inside the image, the figure about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, mythic, overwhelming and radiant, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
